messages:
IncidentBot: SEV2 alert — elevated 5xx and p95 latency spike observed for inference-prod-us-east. Pager: @Maya

Maya: Paging in. Seeing a sharp KV cache miss surge around 02:27 UTC, right when a small quant rollout reached canary shards. p95 around ~1.2s.

Juan: I pulled the deploy history — model redwood-encoder-q8_02 rolled to gp2-east-3 canary at 02:26:48 UTC, ~5% traffic. No other infra changes at that minute.

Li: Queue telemetry shows batching queue depth doubled at the same time. My guess: quant variant increased KV working set, causing more cold lookups + backpressure on batching.

Maya: Capturing traces + metrics to s3: s3://inference/incidents/1745678901/bundle.tar.gz

Maya: Fast mitigation: lower max_batch_size to 8 and enable aggressive kvcache-prefetch on canary pool. Applying change now: `opsctl set-policy gp2-east-3 --max-batch=8 --kvcache-prefetch=aggressive`

IncidentBot: Policy update applied to gp2-east-3 at 02:45 UTC. Monitor for 15m.

Emma: Customer impact: CS reports ~120 unique requests experienced >1s tail latency on streaming endpoints between 02:30–03:10 UTC. Notified top affected customers with interim note.

Maya: After mitigation, canary p95 dropped to ~420ms; KV miss rate decreased ~65%. Leaving mitigations on for now and will hold canary for validation window.

Nate: Can someone export per-shard kv growth and memory delta for the quant variant? Need CSV for graphs in postmortem.

Juan: Added kv_shard_growth and kv_memory_delta metrics to the incident trace. CSV export link: https://internal.tools/metrics/export?incident=1745678901

Maya: Action items to track (will add to remediation board):
- Review quant rollout gating (owner: Juan, due: 2024-06-20)
- Implement seq-length-based kvcache-prefetch heuristic (owner: Li, due: 2024-06-26)
- Add batching guardrails (max queue depth & auto-shrink) to avoid burst blow-ups (owner: Emma, due: 2024-06-24)
- Postmortem writeup + customer impact summary (owner: Maya, due: 2024-06-21)

Li: I'll run microbenchmarks to validate prefetch heuristics under variable seq-len and report results.

Juan: Proposal: add an automated rollout gate that blocks quant rollouts >10% if kv miss rate delta >20% within 30m of rollout. Tentative owner: infra-deploy (Juan).

Nate: After the postmortem, I'll add a CI regression that simulates low KV-hit scenarios against quantized weights (owner: Nate, due: 2024-07-01).

Emma: Scheduling postmortem meeting — proposed 2024-06-22 16:00 UTC. I'll create the invite and attach the incident bundle + CSVs.

Maya: I'll drop a short repro script for the kv-cold + quant case into the incident doc (simple load generator + synthetic seq-len distro).

Li: Created remediation card: https://boards.redwood/remediation/1745678901. Moving checklist items there and linking to PRs.

Juan: Exported canary traces and rollout logs to the postmortem bundle. Also tagging deploy owner for follow-up.

Maya: Confirming no active customer-facing pager now. Canary remains on reduced batch + prefetch for a staged rollback/rollforward plan. Will coordinate handoff in 2 hours.

Emma: Noted for the postmortem: include timeline, customer impact table, mitigation rationale, and follow-up owners.

IncidentBot: Incident state transitioned to MONITORED at 03:30 UTC. This thread now closed for live updates — continue remediation coordination on the remediation board and postmortem doc.
